name: bash-gloss
description: Plain-English gloss under opaque tool calls (shell commands and the scripts they run, subagents, MCP), written by a local Ollama model. No Claude tokens.

host.title: Ollama host
host.description: Base URL of your Ollama server.

model.title: Ollama model
model.description: Required. Name of a model you have pulled, exactly as `ollama list` shows it, e.g. llama3.2:3b or qwen2.5:3b. A small one is plenty. Or skip typing: run /gloss-model to pick from your installed models.

tools.title: Tools to gloss
tools.description: Comma-separated tool names. mcp covers every MCP tool. Also available: Edit, Write, WebFetch, WebSearch. Read, Grep and Glob have their own switch below.

includeReads.title: Also gloss Read, Grep and Glob
includeReads.description: Off by default: these are frequent and mostly self-explanatory.

dialogNotice.title: Also show under the permission dialog
dialogNotice.description: While a call waits for approval, show the gloss under the permission dialog. Finished calls keep their gloss under the row either way.
